2026-10-30.welcome: Back again. Pick a machine, lay the line, start the shift.
2026-10-30.dailyOpen: The board is live today. A checked game puts you on it.
2026-10-30.dailyFinal: Today's board is final. Tomorrow's yard opens at midnight UTC.
2026-10-30.firstDraft: Start simple: something that turns scrap into money before the dock.
2026-10-30.lesson1: Let's make the first shift pay: crusher in line, then start it.
2026-10-30.lesson2: Furnace after crusher. The other way round melts money into slag.
2026-10-30.lesson3: A splitter sends items left and right in turn. One line becomes two.
2026-10-30.lesson4: Rounds four to six are yours. Parts you can't use sell for ten.
2026-10-30.lesson5: Every machine's badge says what it did. Study the waits.
2026-10-30.lesson6: Last round of the lesson. Then the daily is waiting on the title screen.
2026-10-30.refused: Not there. The strip under the grid says why.
2026-10-30.bottleneckDisconnected: Nothing reached the dock last round. A line has to end at one.
2026-10-30.bottleneckDeadEnd: Something points at nothing. Turn it toward the dock.
2026-10-30.bottleneckSlag: Raw scrap in a furnace is slag. Put a crusher in front of it.
2026-10-30.bottleneckSaturated: Items waited behind one machine all round. That's your next pick.
2026-10-30.bottleneckMerge: The merge is the choke. Give one branch its own dock.
2026-10-30.bottleneckStarved: Idle machines mean the hopper is the limit now.
2026-10-30.bottleneckBalanced: That line flows. The next step is more scrap coming in.
2026-10-30.roundGood: That's more money out of the same yard. Good.
2026-10-30.roundFlat: Flat round. Look at the waits before you pick.
2026-10-30.resultsTop: Near the top of the board. Well laid.
2026-10-30.resultsUpper: Above the middle of the board. The slow spot is still in there.
2026-10-30.resultsLower: Not your best shift. The badges say where it went.
2026-10-30.resultsFew: Early in the day; few games on the board yet.
2026-10-30.resultsOffline: No connection, so no board. The game's saved on this device.
2026-10-30.resultsFirst: First shift in the books. Try the daily next.
2026-10-30.streak3: Three days running. The yard notices.
2026-10-30.streak7: A full week. You're a regular.
2026-10-30.streak30: A month straight. That's a hand I'd keep.
2026-10-30.firstCrew: A crew. Now the board is people you know.

2026-10-31.welcome: Six rounds, one yard, the same for everyone today. Let's see what you make of it.

2026-10-31.firstDraft: Start simple: something that turns scrap into money before the dock.
2026-10-31.lesson1: Put the crusher in the belt, back to the hopper. Items only go in from behind.
2026-10-31.lesson2: Twelve dollars an ingot. That's where the money is.
2026-10-31.lesson3: Bring both branches back onto the belt. Conveyors take items from the side.
2026-10-31.lesson4: You know the rules now. From here it's your line.
2026-10-31.lesson5: Fit it in, start the shift, read the badges.
2026-10-31.lesson6: One more shift and you're a hand here.
2026-10-31.refused: Doesn't fit. The reason's in the strip.
2026-10-31.bottleneckDisconnected: Not a cent shipped. Check which way the arrows point.
2026-10-31.bottleneckDeadEnd: Items piled up where the belt stops. Aim it onward.
2026-10-31.bottleneckSlag: Slag pays a dollar. Shards through that furnace would pay twelve.
2026-10-31.bottleneckSaturated: The slow one's named below. A tuner beside it, or a second one.
2026-10-31.bottleneckMerge: One belt can only move one item a second. Split the traffic.
2026-10-31.bottleneckStarved: Your machines are waiting on scrap. More hoppers.
2026-10-31.bottleneckBalanced: Balanced. More hoppers or a second line from here.
2026-10-31.roundGood: That's more money out of the same yard. Good.
2026-10-31.roundFlat: Flat round. Look at the waits before you pick.
2026-10-31.resultsTop: Top of the yard today. Others will study that one.
2026-10-31.resultsUpper: Better than half the yard. Find the wait and go again.
2026-10-31.resultsLower: The board's ahead of you. Watch a recording from the top and try again.
2026-10-31.resultsFew: Early in the day; few games on the board yet.
2026-10-31.resultsOffline: Offline. Your game waits here until we're back on.
2026-10-31.resultsFirst: First game done. Now you know what the dock pays.
2026-10-31.streak3: Three in a row. Habit forming.
2026-10-31.streak7: A full week. You're a regular.
